name: 56310 · Avon, MN
findings: ZIP 56310 (Avon) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56310 (Avon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
